name: Bullet
description: A Y Combinator S26 macOS coding agent that claims to be 30-60% faster than Claude Code and Codex. Designed to eliminate wait times in AI-assisted development by routing coding tasks to the right model. Evolved from an AI hedge fund and browser-use agent into a focused high-speed coding agent.

name: Meta Muse Code
description: Meta's first AI coding agent - a terminal-based coding agent powered by Muse Spark 1.2 model, designed for complex software engineering tasks across large repositories. Features async background agents, local event log for replay-exact execution, and bundled commands like /plan, /grill, and /goal.
community_quotes: Meta's first coding agent designed to compete with OpenAI's Codex and Anthropic's Claude
